paragraphs.notes: Marker [0143] carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right (drawing 1 below).

paragraphs.zh: 向反应釜中加入130mL  THF、10.8g  2-四氢呋喃甲醇(99％，0.105mol)和11.8g叔丁醇钠(98％，0.12mol)，开动搅拌，控制釜温在10℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钠盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应4h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至3，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.0g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为96.6％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率91.4％。
paragraphs.en: Into the reactor were added 130 mL THF, 10.8 g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99%, 0.105 mol) and 11.8 g sodium tert-butoxide (98%, 0.12 mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 10 degC. The sodium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.3%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.0 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid at a content of 96.6%, and a two-step reaction yield of 91.4% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: This is step (2) of Example 11; step (1) is on the preceding page. The base named in the prose is sodium tert-butoxide, matching C4H9ONa over the arrow in drawing 1.

paragraphs.zh: (1)2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (1) Preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:
paragraphs.notes: The heading names the salt generically ("benzoate salt") without saying which cation; the drawing that follows shows the potassium salt.
Marker [0147] carries no prose. It labels the reaction scheme drawn to its right (drawing 2 below).

paragraphs.zh: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇200mL，开动搅拌，室温下将4.1g金属钾(99％，0.105mol)加入其中，待金属钾溶解完全后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应6h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.1％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
paragraphs.en: Into the reaction flask was added 200 mL tert-butanol; stirring was started and 4.1 g metallic potassium (99%, 0.105 mol) was added at room temperature. After the metallic potassium had completely dissolved, the kettle temperature was controlled at 25 degC and 34.8 g methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate (98%, 0.1 mol) was poured into the kettle for the alkaline hydrolysis reaction. The reaction was slightly exothermic; the kettle temperature was controlled at 25 degC and the reaction run for 6 h. At the end of the reaction, liquid chromatography in-process control gave a normalised content of 98.1% for the potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate. The solvent was stripped off completely under reduced pressure and the material used directly in the subsequent etherification reaction.
paragraphs.notes: The Chinese term rendered here as "alkaline hydrolysis" is literal; here it is the saponification of the methyl ester by potassium tert-butoxide formed in situ from metallic potassium in tert-butanol. The patent does not spell that out.

paragraphs.zh: (2)2-氯-3-[(RS)-四氢呋喃-2-基甲氧基甲基]-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的制备，主要反应过程可以以如下反应方程式表示：
paragraphs.en: (2) Preparation of 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid; the main reaction process can be represented by the following reaction equation:

paragraphs.en: Into the reactor were added 130 mL DMF, 10.8 g 2-tetrahydrofurfuryl alcohol (99%, 0.105 mol) and 14.1 g potassium tert-butoxide (95%, 0.12 mol); stirring was started and the kettle temperature was controlled at 10 degC. The potassium 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate prepared in step (1) (98.1%, 0.1 mol) was added to the reaction flask in eight portions, with a total addition time of 3 h; after addition was complete the mixture was held at temperature and reacted for 4 h. When the reaction was complete, the solvent was stripped under reduced pressure, 120 mL water was added to the kettle residue, and after stirring to dissolve, concentrated hydrochloric acid was added dropwise to acidify the system to pH 3. After filtration, water rinsing and drying, 33.0 g of product was obtained; HPLC assay gave the target compound 2-chloro-3-[(RS)-tetrahydrofuran-2-ylmethoxymethyl]-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid at a content of 96.8%, and a two-step reaction yield of 91.8% based on methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate.
paragraphs.notes: The solvent here is DMF, whereas the otherwise parallel paragraph [0144] uses THF. Both are as printed.

paragraphs.zh: (1)与实施例1所述步骤相同，得到含量为98.2％的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯
paragraphs.en: (1) Following the same procedure as described in Example 1, 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylben[zoic acid, truncated] with a content of 98.2% was obtained

substituents: C(=O)O-Na+ at C1 (drawn as NaO-C(=O)-, a covalent Na-O bond)
structures.name: sodium 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate

structures.core: benzene (benzoic acid) plus a pendant tetrahydrofuran (oxolane) ring
structures.name: 2-chloro-3-{[(oxolan-2-yl)methoxy]methyl}-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoic acid

drawings.notes: The oxolane ring is attached through its C2; the attachment bond is a plain line with no wedge or hash, so no configuration is drawn, consistent with the (RS) label used in the prose. The pendant ring is drawn as a five-membered ring with one ring oxygen. The two reagents above the arrow are printed on one line separated by a Chinese enumeration comma; they are recorded as separate list items.

drawings.notes: Nothing at all is written below this arrow; the space is empty, not illegible. The single label above the arrow is the bare element symbol K (metallic potassium per [0148]). Both salts are drawn with the metal bonded to oxygen rather than as separated ions; the SMILES records them as the ionic species.
